title: Concept: Resolved pin whose revision is not a full SHA
description: Package.resolved declares a pin whose revision is shorter than 40 hex characters, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a pin whose revision is shorter than 40 hex characters.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Package.resolved (swift).
risk: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a pin whose revision is shorter than 40 hex characters.
